cc:Work.dc:title: Map of the vote chain
cc:Work.dc:description: Twelve steps of the vote, from registration to publication, each with its verification status (verified, partial or not verifiable with public data) and the corresponding test; the link between typed vote and recorded vote is highlighted as not verifiable with public data.
